_comment: Team frame groupings, shown in the frame browser under Team groupings. Add one by pasting the object from a designer's Share with team file into the list. Codes match library frame codes.

groupings.name: Ford: Standard
groupings.note: For framed prints or paper work with glass. From Ford's Frame Specifications page. BW26-409 White (Framerica) is not in the FRAME library yet.

groupings.name: Ford: Floater
groupings.note: For wrapped canvases and other mediums without glass. From Ford's Frame Specifications page.

groupings.name: Ford: Shadowbox
groupings.note: Extra deep frames for dimensional artwork, glass or raised prints. From Ford's Frame Specifications page.
